problems: accept regex rejected the common '1 (bir) yıl' / '10 (on) yıl' notation (parenthetical only allowed digit form)
changes: parenthetical number group now accepts both digit and word form

problems: prompt asks for both the period and its starting point, but accept only checked 'üç ay'; an answer with a wrong start (e.g. 'ölüm tarihinden') passed
changes: accept now requires üç ay AND start at learning of the death (ölümünü öğrenme / haberdar olma), either order

problems: prompt asks when the period starts, but accept only checked 'bir yıl'; a wrong start (e.g. dava/boşanma tarihi) passed
changes: accept now requires bir yıl AND kesinleşme (boşanma hükmünün kesinleşmesi), either order

problems: prompt asks who is liable and which court; accept only checked the court location, so an answer naming the tapu memuru/müdürü as liable passed
changes: accept now requires Devlet (or Hazine, its litigating representative) AND tapu sicilinin bulunduğu/tutulduğu yer, either order

problems: accept rejected the common phrasing 'hayata kasıt' (only 'hayata kast' matched)
changes: accept now matches hayata kast / hayata kasıt

problems: prompt has two parts (iptal yürürlük tarihi + whether süresiz nafaka is still available today); accept only checked the date, so 'hayır, artık istenemez' passed
changes: accept now requires 30/6/2027 AND an affirmative (istenebilir / evet / hâlâ / hâlen / yürürlükte), either order
